text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Drawing upon all her past experiences as 
fuel, Ikuno Dictus conquered the 
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later. Ikuno Dictus suggested the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup and the Mile Championship 
as her goals for the autumn and beyond.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants to further hone her 
weapon—experience—and aim for greater 
heights. The Trainer also recommended 
entering the All Comers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, seeing Ikuno Dictus's race 
record, interest in maintenance and 
condition management surged among many 
Trainers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two decided to share "IRON WILL" and 
the data within it far and wide. For the 
future they desire—next up is the All 
Comers.
